ops.title: Lexicon: break/broken DOMAIN_OVERRIDES cross-backend divergence
ops.description: Found by a probe while making test_rust_filter_decisions_match_spacy hermetic (2026-07-10 sweep): 'this is broken' scores -3 on Rust/udpipe (lemma 'broken', DOMAIN_OVERRIDES['broken']=-3) but -2 on spaCy (lemma 'break', DOMAIN_OVERRIDES['break']=-2), crossing HOSTILE_FLOOR=3 on one backend only. Root cause: the two override entries encode different intent ('broken' is more negative than 'break') and the lemmatizers pick different entries. Naive value-reconciliation damages the 'break' entry ('take a break'); a real fix needs design (e.g. surface-form lookup before lemma, like afinn itself). Production unaffected (one backend runs at a time), but Rust-ext vs pure-spaCy users disagree on such inputs. Related: df3f7d8.

ops.text: udpipe and spaCy paths score 'this is broken' identically, or divergence encoded as a tracked known-divergence test
